INT_ATT_01.title: Mandatory Attendance Counseling & Faculty Mentor Check-in
INT_ATT_01.description: Schedule a 1-on-1 mentor session to identify root causes of absenteeism (commute, medical, health) and create a daily check-in schedule.

INT_ATT_02.title: Parent / Guardian Attendance Advisory Notification
INT_ATT_02.description: Send official institutional alert regarding 75% AICTE/UGC debarment risk to parent/guardian with automated attendance tracking updates.

INT_ATT_03.title: Subject-Specific Make-up Class & Lab Session Allocation
INT_ATT_03.description: Assign dedicated weekend laboratory slots and remedial theory attendance reconciliation sessions for lagging subjects.

INT_ACAD_01.title: Peer Tutoring & Department Remedial Session Assignment
INT_ACAD_01.description: Pair student with a high-performing departmental peer mentor and enroll in weekly remedial coaching for core engineering subjects.

INT_ACAD_02.title: Backlog Clearance Action Plan & Academic Strategy Roadmap
INT_ACAD_02.description: Formulate a customized semester study roadmap with the Head of Department (HOD) prioritizing uncleared prerequisite backlogs.

INT_ACAD_03.title: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) Retest Opportunity
INT_ACAD_03.description: Grant eligibility for internal improvement quizzes and supplementary assignment submissions to recover internal marks deficit.

INT_FIN_01.title: Institutional Fee-Waiver & Emergency Financial Aid Desk Referral
INT_FIN_01.description: Fast-track application for institute emergency hardship funds, alumni tuition grants, and flexible installment fee payment schedules.

INT_FIN_02.title: State/National Post-Matric Scholarship Desk Assistance
INT_FIN_02.description: Assign institutional scholarship coordinator to resolve pending documentation and disburse government welfare subsidies (NSP, PMSSS, SC/ST/EWS).

INT_FIN_03.title: Hostel Subsidized Accommodation & Commute Relief Support
INT_FIN_03.description: Evaluate long-distance day-scholar transit burden and allocate emergency subsidized campus hostel room or college bus pass concession.

INT_BEH_01.title: Professional Student Counselor & Wellbeing Consultation
INT_BEH_01.description: Refer student to campus counseling center for confidential mental health support, motivation assessment, and personal guidance.

INT_BEH_02.title: Digital LMS Onboarding & Learning Resource Assistance
INT_BEH_02.description: Provide dedicated orientation on accessing digital lecture recordings, e-library repositories, and interactive quiz modules.

INT_BEH_03.title: First-Generation Learner Academic Navigation Mentorship
INT_BEH_03.description: Connect student with senior student mentors and faculty advisers experienced in guiding first-generation collegiate scholars.
